market_outlook.short_term: Risk-off regime persists. Oil above $101 and Iran escalation dominate. Bessent's FX intervention backfiring creates bond market volatility. Expect equity volatility (VIX elevated) through US election cycle. Asian stocks pressured by oil-driven inflation fears. Gold near $4,400 provides safe-haven bid. 1-3 months: choppy, headline-driven, energy and defense outperform.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 months: AI capex cycle remains structural tailwind for semiconductors and data center infrastructure. Trade wars (US-Canada, US-China) create supply chain reshoring beneficiaries. If Iran conflict de-escalates post-election, oil normalizes and inflation eases. Housing affordability crisis persists. EM rotation to Indonesia/SE Asia continues. Gold outperforms silver into 2027. Monitor Fed path and Bessent policy consistency.
